registry_rules: Every fact has one canonical fact_id and default semantic role.
Fact registry completeness is knowledge completeness, not live acquisition completeness.
Source hints are not acquisition success; P02 must bind/attempt sources.
Target price and technical features remain downstream and non-causal.
Private/paid facts stay registered as gaps rather than silently omitted.
Horizon relevance does not imply observation freshness.
Causal root eligibility does not imply automatic additive voting; P03 must apply shock ownership/dependence.
default_role must be registered in config/fact_role_registry.json.
Every list field is unique and deterministic; duplicate horizons/terms are invalid.
Structural root evidence may inform a causal root prior only through the explicit structural-to-causal bridge; it never becomes intraday flow or direct session Direction by relabeling.
